source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The acrylic chamber (Fig. 1) was designed to facilitate the delivery of ultrasonic energy to the hippocampal slice. Thus, the transducer (Harisonics Corp.) designed for high-power applications, with a center frequency of 750 kHz, a focal length of 7.6 cm, and a diameter of 2.5 cm, was positioned at the bottom of the chamber so that the focal point could be placed just above the center of the tissue-supporting net and therefore within the hippocampal slice.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Cellular and dendritic field potential responses evoked by electrical stimulation of the Schaffer/Commissural afferents were examined before, during and after exposure of a portion of the CA1 region to focused ultrasound pulses for periods ranging from 2 to 15 min.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.ispta_w_cm2: Transducer calibrations at low power levels following standard reciprocity techniques14 were extrapolated to operational levels yielding a spatial-peak-temporal-average intensity no greater than 82 W/cm², which is well below the cavitation threshold5,6,23.
source_quotes.n_subjects: The experiments were divided into 4 sets. Set A consisted of 6 experiments designed to study the dendritic field potential; set B 6 experiments for the fiber volley; set C one experiment for the population spike. The 9 experiments of set D were used to study possible thermal effects.

flags.reason: A stated pulse repetition rate of 150 kHz together with a ~6 microsecond pulse duration implies pulses repeating almost back-to-back (~90% duty cycle), which is unusual for a device described as delivering discrete 'pulses'; the paper does not reconcile this, so the stated PRF is recorded as-is without independently computing a duty cycle.
The Methods state the calibrated ISPTA is 'no greater than 82 W/cm2', while the Abstract restates this as 'about 80 W/cm2'; the more precise Methods value (82) is recorded here.
Reported as the four per-set experiment counts (6, 6, 1, 9); the paper never states a combined total number of slice preparations used.

readout_other: Extracellular field potentials (presynaptic fiber volley, population dendritic potential, population spike) evoked by electrical stimulation of Schaffer/Commissural afferents, recorded in the CA1 region of the hippocampal slice
direction_notes: Focused ultrasound pulses significantly reduced the presynaptic fiber volley (mean -21%) and population dendritic potential (mean -46%) amplitudes, and reduced the population spike (-15%) in a single experiment; recovery after ultrasound cessation was partial or complete in most experiments followed.

exposures.label: Focused ultrasound pulses to the CA1 region of the in vitro hippocampal slice

timing.protocol_description: A 750 kHz focused transducer delivered repeated ~6 microsecond acoustic pulses (generated from 100 ns electrical voltage spikes) at a pulse repetition rate of 150 kHz to a small region of the CA1 hippocampal slice, continuously for periods of 2 to 15 min (mean 9.4 min for the fiber-volley experiments; mean 7 min for the dendritic-potential experiments), while electrical stimulation of the Schaffer/Commissural afferents was delivered once every 20 s throughout baseline, ultrasound exposure, and (in some experiments) a recovery period.
